items.title: Clippers rerouting the 2027 Philadelphia 2nd, which they got in the Johni Broome deal, to land Max Strus, even on an expiring, is a pretty good piece of business. They got something for John Collins leaving and turned it all into a very viable rotation piece. Hard to find fault.
items.author: Justin Russo
